name: File upload
looksLike: choose file button beside a filename
box where I attach a document
area asking me to drop a file or browse
definition: A control for selecting files to send to an application. It may include a drop area, but must also offer a keyboard-operable file picker.

notConfusedWith.difference: Accepts typed text rather than a file selected from the device.

prompts.short: Add a labeled file upload with a file picker and clear file-type guidance.
prompts.detailed: Add a native file input with a visible label and associated help text. Explain accepted types and size limits, report validation errors beside the field, and show upload progress separately from selection. Keep a keyboard-operable picker even if drag and drop is offered; validate uploads on the server.

html: <input id="attachment" name="attachment" type="file" accept=".pdf,application/pdf" aria-describedby="attachment-help" style="min-height:44px; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box">
Choose a PDF. Selecting a file does not upload it yet.
<!-- Submit using your application's upload flow and validate the file on the server; accept is only a picker hint. -->

a11yNotes: Associate a visible label and file requirements
Offer keyboard file selection, not drag and drop alone
Announce validation errors and upload status without moving focus unexpectedly
